title: feat: implement top-level Rust workspace (ADR-041)
summary:
> **Note:** This PR was re-created from #3029 due to repository maintenance. Your code and branch are intact. @lucarlig please verify everything looks good.

Implements [ADR-041: Top-Level Rust Workspace](docs/docs/architecture/adr/041-top-level-rust-workspace.md). All Rust code is now part of a single workspace at the repository root, with one set of commands and one CI workflow for building, testing, and releasing.

#### Summary

- **Workspace at repo root**  
  Root `Cargo.toml` and `Cargo.lock` define a workspace. Rust crates live under `crates/` (e.g. `crates/plugins/`, `crates/tools/`, `crates/gateway_rs/`, `crates/mcp-servers/`). A single `cargo build` / `cargo test` at the repo root builds and tests all Rust code.

- **Single Rust CI workflow**  
  Replaces the separate Rust Plugins and Rust Tools workflows with one [`.github/workflows/rust.yml`](.github/workflows/rust.yml) that:
  - Runs on `ubuntu-latest` and `macos-latest` (no Windows; Makefile assumes a Unix shell).
  - Triggers on changes under `crates/**`, root `Cargo.toml`/`Cargo.lock`, `rust-toolchain.toml`, `deny.toml`, and the workflow file.
  - Uses Makefile targets for: build + stub generation/verification, `rust-fmt-check`, `rust-lint` (clippy), `rust-test`, wheel build, `rust-audit`, `rust-licenses`, `rust-bench-check`, coverage, docs, and (on tags) release/publish.

- **Makefile as single entrypoint**  
  All Rust operations go through `make` targets (e.g. `rust-build-check`, `rust-fmt-check`, `rust-lint`, `rust-test`, `rust-build-wheels`, `rust-audit`, `rust-licenses`, `rust-coverage`, `rust-doc`, `rust-release` / `rust-release-publish`). CI and local dev use the same commands.

- **Pre-commit**  
  Adds a local hook that runs Rust fmt, build, and clippy when Rust is installed and when files under `crates/`, `Cargo.toml`, `Cargo.lock`, or `rust-toolchain.toml` change. Path exclusions and hook config were updated from `plugins_rust/` / `tools_rust/` to the new `crates/` paths.

- **Docs and config**  
  [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) and pre-commit config now refer to `crates/plugins/` and `crates/tools/` instead of `plugins_rust/` and `tools_rust/`.

#### Consequences (per ADR-041)

- One place to run Rust: `make rust-check` (and related targets) at repo root.
- One CI workflow for Rust; fewer duplicated jobs and caches.
- Shared root `.venv` for maturin builds when using the top-level workspace.
- Easier to add new Rust crates under `crates/` and to do cross-crate refactors.

#### Related

- ADR: [041-top-level-rust-workspace.md](docs/docs/architecture/adr/041-top-level-rust-workspace.md)
- Issue: [#3027](https://github.com/IBM/mcp-context-forge/issues/3027)
